root_cause.text: The `folio_unmap_pte_batch` function used `folio_pte_batch` which did not respect individual PTE writable and soft-dirty bits, causing all PTEs in the batch to be restored with the same permissions (e.g., writable) even if some were originally non-writable, thereby violating anonymous memory/CoW semantics.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "If the batch has a mix of writable and non-writable bits, we may end up setting the entire batch writable. Fix this by respecting writable bit during batching." The patch replaces `folio_pte_batch` with `folio_pte_batch_flags` using `FPB_RESPECT_WRITE | FPB_RESPECT_SOFT_DIRTY` to preserve the original writable and soft-dirty bits per PTE.
